authority: POWO/WCVP direct accepted species pages, with author-sensitive historical synonym checks
scope: accepted names, spelling, rank, genus/family, aliases, homonyms only
recovery_preflight: Prior Oxalis stricta batch 085 and Physalis cinerascens batch 104 both published and Sheet Z mirrored; no safe unpublished handoff from those candidates.

records.synonym_note: POWO accepts five subspecies (divaricatum, eximium, radicans, rydbergii, verrucosum); historical Rhus radicans L. is homotypic. Source species rank cannot be silently reduced to any subspecies; Toxicodendron rydbergii source concept separately reconciled in earlier batch.
records.concept_action: Preserve species-rank source and existing distinct subspecies/alias treatment; no photo ID or range decision.

records.synonym_note: POWO accepts species; Tradescantia australis Bush is heterotypic synonym, Tradescantia discolor Raf. is illegitimate later homonym. Author is essential: never collapse other independently authored Tradescantia discolor names by epithet alone.
records.concept_action: Keep canonical hirsutiflora concept; preserve author-sensitive synonym caution.

records.synonym_note: POWO accepts species; Typha angustifolia subsp. domingensis (Pers.) Rohrb. and T. angustifolia var. domingensis (Pers.) Griseb. are homotypic synonyms. Do not equate the species with accepted T. angustifolia solely from historic combinations; specimen/hybrid identity not checked.
records.concept_action: Preserve separate Typha domingensis learner concept; historical names aliases only.

records.synonym_note: POWO accepts species; historical T. latifolia var. orientalis (C.Presl) Rohrb. is synonym of separately accepted Typha orientalis, not of T. latifolia; T. latifolia subsp. eulatifolia was not validly published. Do not assign historic varieties automatically.
records.concept_action: Retain Typha latifolia species concept and avoid misleading rank/homonym aliases.

records.synonym_note: POWO accepts V. americana; Vallisneria spiralis var. americana (Michx.) Torr. is homotypic synonym. But historical Vallisneria americana var. biwaensis is placed under separately accepted V. natans. Source occurrence identity and prior range evidence remain unreviewed.
records.concept_action: Preserve species concept; do not equate historical biwaensis variety or change county/range status.

records.synonym_note: POWO accepts Verbena scabra Vahl; historical Verbena scabra Muhl. ex Spreng. is illegitimate later homonym mapped to Phyla lanceolata, not Verbena scabra Vahl. POWO synonyms of Vahl taxon include forms angustifolia and ternifolia. Author-sensitive mapping required.
records.concept_action: Preserve accepted Verbena scabra Vahl and avoid Phyla lanceolata homonym merge.

records.synonym_note: POWO accepts Urochloa texana; Brachiaria texana (Buckley) S.T.Blake and Panicum texanum Buckley are homotypic synonyms. Alternative historic grass taxonomies accepted Brachiaria texana; do not create separate learner concepts.
records.concept_action: Keep Urochloa texana accepted canonical name; retain historic Brachiaria/Panicum names as aliases.

records.synonym_note: POWO accepts Tinantia anomala; Tradescantia anomala Torr., Commelinantia anomala (Torr.) Tharp and Commelina anomala (Torr.) Woodson are homotypic synonyms; Tradescantia texensis M.E.Jones is heterotypic synonym. Preserve original aliases without duplicate cards.
records.concept_action: Keep existing Tinantia anomala learner concept and historic genus combinations as aliases.
